summary: Plan completed and committed (56d1ba6). The task shape is cross-cutting, with nine phases across AnsibleSpecs, Architecture, JenkinsPipelineUtils, ArgoCDDeploy (the native registry, then a hand-over gated by one setting) and Ansible (the switch runbook, argo-migrate, recommend-resources, docs). attachments/registry-switch.md defines the switch protocol, verification.json holds 23 criteria, and the close-out has four out-of-scope suggestions. One ruling's premise is wrong: ArgoCDDeploy has no relay webhook today (its only hook goes to Jenkins), so the switch runbook adds one as an operator step.
